chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who had a bondwoman with whom he used to have relations. Then he sold her, and she was freed and married, and gave birth to a daughter. Is her daughter permissible for her former master?
He said: "She is forbidden to him."

key_terms.جَارِيَةٌ: a female bondwoman owned by a master
key_terms.يَأْتِيهَا: he had sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: Is the daughter of a former bondwoman permissible for her previous master to marry?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning prohibited marriage relations arising from prior relations with a bondwoman. The Imam عليه السلام states that the daughter born to that former bondwoman after her later marriage remains forbidden to the former master, establishing a ruling of hurmah in this case.
